title: Function signature mismatch: tx_queue_empty const vs non-const
description: Implementation at line 407 declares 'bool tx_queue_empty(const struct tx_queue *queue)' but header tx_queue.h:202 declares 'bool tx_queue_empty(struct tx_queue *_Nonnull queue)' without const. Compiler error: 'conflicting types for tx_queue_empty'.
close_reason: Fixed tx_queue_empty and tx_queue_stats_get signature mismatch - removed const from implementations to match header declarations (non-const due to internal locking). tx_queue_count correctly keeps const per its 'logically const' API design.
